title: aback-ui.json
description: Project configuration written by `aback-ui init` and read by every other aback-ui command.

framework.description: The framework detected by init, such as "next" or "vite".

rsc.description: True when the project uses React Server Components, so client components keep their "use client" directive.

css.description: The global stylesheet, relative to the project root. init adds the theme import to it.

aliases.description: Import aliases from your tsconfig paths. They decide where files are written.

registries.description: Registry templates by scope. The standard "@aback" entry means the registry bundled with the CLI; any other URL is used as a mirror.
